title: Local section formula for the raw homogeneous ideal-tensor kernel map
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], $J=\ker j$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] with $J^2=0$ [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], and $L$ invertible [def-sc-invertible-module]. Use the canonical tensor-pullback adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], its unit $\eta$, and the canonical ideal-kernel and pullback-tensor comparisons [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. For $a,d,t\in\mathbb N$, $h:d+a=t$, and $s:\mathcal O_Z\to j^*(L^a)$, let $m$ be the composite inverse right unitor, $j^*(J\otimes L^d)\otimes s$, inverse pullback tensor comparison, and pullback of the associator followed by $J\otimes\operatorname{tensorPowAddIso}_{d,a}^{-1}$ and degree transport $h$. Let $v:K_d\to K_t$ be the composite inverse ideal-kernel comparison, $\eta_{J\otimes L^d}$, $j_*m$, inverse $\eta_{J\otimes L^t}$, and target ideal-kernel comparison, where $K_r=\ker\eta_{L^r}$. For every open $U\subset X$, local section $x\in\Gamma(U,L^a)$ with $\eta(x)=s(1)|_U$, and $y\in\Gamma(U,K_d)$, the inclusion of $v(y)$ equals the degree-transported section $\operatorname{tensorPowAddIso}_{d,a}^{-1}(\operatorname{incl}(y)\otimes x)$. There is no graded algebra presentation or quotient action in this assertion.

proof.text: By lem-sc-pullback-tensor-unit-section the ordinary pullback cotensorator takes the adjunction-unit image of a section tensor to the tensor of the two unit images. Transport this formula along boundaryPullbackComparison, using the unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identity. Expanding boundaryPullbackTensorIso and canceling the comparison isomorphisms proves the same formula for the tensor-formula pullback.

Transport y to z in J tensor L^d through the inverse ideal-kernel comparison. Its defining inclusion equation identifies the included y with ideal multiplication q_d(z). Naturality of s and hx identify s applied to 1 over j inverse U with the unit image of x. Expand the explicit map: the inverse right unitor inserts 1, tensoring by s inserts this unit image, and the inverse tensor comparison changes the section tensor to the unit image of z tensor x.

Let f be the associator followed by multiplication of degrees d and a and transport along h. Unit naturality changes the pulled-back f applied to the preceding unit image to the unit on J tensor L^t applied to f(z tensor x). Square-zero ideal annihilation makes that unit invertible, so its displayed inverse cancels. The target comparison inclusion equation gives q_t(f(z tensor x)).

Whisker exchange, left-unitor naturality, associator naturality and leftUnitor_tensor_hom show f followed by q_t equals q_d whiskered by L^a followed by tensorPowAddIso inverse and the degree transport. Evaluate on z tensor x and use whiskerRight_app_tmulSection and the source inclusion equation. This is the claimed equality, with arbitrary degrees including zero and on arbitrary opens including the empty open.

theorem tensorIdealSection_local_multiplication {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hI : j.ker ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (a d t : ℕ) (h : d + a = t)
    (s : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ (tensorPullback j).obj (L.tensorPow a))
    (U : X.Opens) (x : Γ(L.tensorPow a, U))
    (hx : (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow a)).app U x =
      ((pushforward j).obj ((tensorPullback j).obj (L.tensorPow a))).val.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op (s.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(Z, ⊤))))
    (y : Γ(kernel (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow d)), U)) :
  let m : (tensorPullback j).obj (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow d) ⟶
      (tensorPullback j).obj (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow t) :=
    (ρ_ _).inv ≫ ((tensorPullback j).obj (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow d)) ◁ s ≫
      (boundaryPullbackTensorIso j (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow d)
        (L.tensorPow a)).inv ≫
      (tensorPullback j).map ((α_ _ _ _).hom ≫
        j.ker.toModules ◁ (L.tensorPowAddIso d a).inv ≫
        j.ker.toModules ◁ eqToHom (congrArg L.tensorPow h))
  let _inst := square_zero_ideal_tensor_unit_isIso j L hI t
  let v : kernel (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow d)) ⟶
      kernel (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow t)) :=
    (boundaryIdealKernelIso j (L.tensorPow d)).inv ≫
    (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
      (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow d) ≫
    (pushforward j).map m ≫
    inv ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
      (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow t)) ≫
    (boundaryIdealKernelIso j (L.tensorPow t)).hom
  (kernel.ι (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow t))).app U (v.app U y) =
    (eqToHom (congrArg L.tensorPow h)).app U
      ((L.tensorPowAddIso d a).inv.app U
        (tmulSection ((kernel.ι (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow d))).app U y) x))
